The Program's Definition returns one array (`out`) and the Build recorded no return slot for the row -- the tuple slot is Python's, invisible to the Program (the row-parallel linear returns the all-reduced tensor as slot 0: an all-reduce of any world takes the slot of its rank-local operand when that operand is a Linear's reading its own weight)
the Build records RoPE's return slots by keyword (`query` / `key`); v1 spells them as the tuple index of `RotaryEmbedding.forward -> (q, k)`.  Same slot, two spellings
v1 encodes the token ids a module consumes as `<consuming module>/in` (family input_token_ids): the Value is the prompt input or the previous step's sampled id, spelt at its consumer
v1 encodes the sampling event's output under the fixed path `runner.sampler` (the root body has no module path)
v1 encodes a registered weight as `<field path>/weight` with an open range, once per rank
the attention M1 stream is a kernel-side stream under `fa2.m1/L<k>` (k = the attention body's ordinal); its member is the launch geometry (v1 `_fa2_geometry` / `_fa3_geometry`)

TP-04: a collective's rank-local operand (the one Value of this rank it reads; its other operands are the received peer partials) is required per rank beside the collective's output, under the collective's module, as `part_rank<r>` (all-reduce) / `shard_rank<r>` (all-gather), family `tp_rank_partials`

a collective whose rank-local operand another module produced is a collective SITE of the module whose forward calls it, at the site path `<enclosing module>.<fx node>`: the collector hooks the enclosing module and commits its k-th collective of the step as occurrence k, so the site's identities live at (enclosing module, k) -- k in Program order, from 1 when the enclosing module has required Values of its own -- and the site path is an `op_path_aliases` entry
a norm's scale is the one f32 per row its rsqrt produces inside the norm's module body; under the norm-scale policy it is required as `<norm module>/norm_scale`, family norm_scales

policy.prescribed_inputs: every field of the Program's record-typed parameters
protocol_required: returned tensors: all rows / ports of an fx node's output once one crosses (TENSOR-RETURN)

query.query_text: Q_word_v1{X=16,W=32,R=no-recompute}: units = the word units of every Call's cut (verity.ir.cut; verity/partition/v1 names the partition as Q_word v1 {X: 16, W: 32}); committed = every Value one Call produces and another Call reads or the Program returns, and the prescribed inputs a Call reads (U_C (in(C) u out(C)) over the Calls), minus the Program's literals (the Values of Calls that read no Value: written in the descriptor, never acquired); plus each Call's committed interior words (the tap families); policy: prescribed = record-typed inputs (weights); protocol = sampling-event outputs + recorded return slots + returned tensors (every Value of an fx node's output at a step once any of them crosses the module body boundary); hidden = fa2_hidden_m1_stream; profile = ampere; norm scales: one f32 per norm Call per row, `<norm module>/norm_scale` (family norm_scales): the interior scale of RMSNormFusedCuda_v2, RMSNormTriton_v1 (norm-scale tap) and the output of RsqrtF32_v1 bound per row (protocol-required); router softmax: per token row of MoeRouterTopKOrderedNorm_v1, MoeRouterTopKOrdered_v1 the committed softmax -- max, E exponentials, 1/sum, E probabilities (+ TOPK selected probabilities and the scale under renormalize) -- `moe/L<k>/router_softmax` (family router_softmax, router-softmax tap); vocabulary range: per token row of EmbeddingShard_v1 the rank's committed range values -- tok - START (i32), START <= tok, tok <= START + VS - 1 (1 bit each) -- `<embedding module>/vocab_range` (family vocab_range, int32 [rows, 3]); guarded max: in every attention Call, GuardNegInfZero(m) of each key block after a query row's first is committed as word 3 of that (row, head, block)'s ROW entry in the attention hidden stream, and max * scale of every key block as that (row, head, block)'s word of the stream's MS class (the guarded-max tap build)
